fact: On 23 October 2025 the eGabon-SIS technical committee and the World Bank found the system in effective use at the Lalala and Glass health centres in Libreville, two of thirteen pilot sites in Grand Libreville, where the Lalala chief doctor said a patient can now be found in different facilities under a unique identifier and the World Bank's specialist said information entered there can be retrieved at another hospital.
title: eGabon-SIS : La Banque mondiale évalue la mise en œuvre du projet dans le Grand Libreville
